content.what_it_is: MATLAB postprocessor that finds first modeled and measured WG1 free-surface maxima (L16-L30), translates the model time base by their time difference (L32), loads modeled and measured C-station velocity data (L35-L40,L51-L56), and plots U and V comparison panels (L42-L73).

equations.ref: translate model time between peak times
repeat modeled extraction for V panel

verbatim_spans.text: t=t-num_t_shift+exp_t_shift; % some difference between eta and u

unresolved: L38-L39 and L54-L55 allocate six velocity columns but copy nn-1 columns without checking nn-1<=6; inputs wider than seven columns fail assignment.
L43 and L63 require at least 25 measured rows for mean(veldata(1:25,2)) without a size check.
t comes from the FSE file (L11,L32) while vel comes from VT_C (L39,L55); no check ensures equal row counts before plotting at L46 and L67.
The V plot uses vel(:,2) at L67; if VT_C has only time plus one component, that column remains zeros from L54 and missing V data is silently rendered as zero.
The comment at L66 says the measurement has a 0.25 lag, but no 0.25 correction is applied to either measured or modeled time in the following plot at L67.
Exact maximum comparisons and immediate breaks (L17-L20,L25-L28) select the first tied maximum without an explicit tie policy.
